trip.title: Bier Reisen 2021
trip.subtitle: Bamberg to the Allgäu, then seven nights in Munich
trip.route_line: Porto Alegre → Frankfurt → Bamberg → Nuremberg → Essing → Traunstein → Schönram → Berchtesgaden → Nesselwang → Missen-Wilhams → Munich → Frankfurt

stops.name: Porto Alegre
stops.note: Departure, 29 October — overnight flight to Frankfurt.

stops.name: Frankfurt Airport
stops.note: Land on 30 October, pick up the car, straight to Franconia.

stops.name: Bamberg
stops.note: Hotel Andres, Heiliggrabstraße 1 — two nights in the Rauchbier capital.

stops.name: Nuremberg
stops.note: Leonard Hotel, Zufuhrstraße 22 — one night inside the old walls.

stops.name: Essing
stops.note: Gasthaus Felsenwastl, Unterer Markt 19 — Danube gorge, Weltenburg next door.

stops.name: Traunstein
stops.note: Hotel Rosenheimer Hof — Chiemgau gateway, key box at the back door.

stops.name: Schönram (Petting)
stops.note: Private Landbrauerei Schönram — the stop that justifies the detour.

stops.name: Berchtesgaden
stops.note: Alpensport-Hotel Seimler, Maria am Berg — two nights under the Watzmann.

stops.name: Nesselwang
stops.note: Brauerei-Gasthof Hotel Post, Hauptstraße 25 — sleep above the brewhouse.

stops.name: Missen-Wilhams
stops.note: Brauereigasthof Schäffler, Hauptstraße 15 — Allgäu village brewery.

stops.name: Munich
stops.note: Hotel Italia, Schillerstraße 19 — seven nights, the long Munich finish.

stops.name: Frankfurt Airport
stops.note: 15 November — 404 km from Munich, then the flight home.

days.title: Porto Alegre → Frankfurt
items: Overnight flight POA → FRA (10,665 km, ~13 h 30 in the air)
Dinner at the airport before boarding
The car is waiting in Frankfurt in the morning

days.title: Frankfurt → Bamberg
items: 213 km / 2 h 18 east on the A3 and A70
Hotel Andres, Heiliggrabstraße 1 — drop the bags inside the old town
First evening: Schlenkerla for Rauchbier, or Spezial if the smoke is too much

days.title: Bamberg
items: Brewery crawl through the old town: Schlenkerla, Spezial, Fässla, Mahr's, Klosterbräu
Greifenklau for the view over the city
Sunday in Franconia — check which taprooms open before committing to a plan

days.title: Bamberg → Nuremberg
items: 60 km / 0 h 52 south on the A73
Leonard Hotel, Zufuhrstraße 22, Mitte
Altstadthof in the rock cellars, then Schanzenbräu on the hill

days.title: Nuremberg → Essing
items: 107 km / 1 h 28 south-east towards the Danube
Gasthaus Felsenwastl, Unterer Markt 19
Weltenburg Abbey across the gorge if there is light left

days.title: Essing → Traunstein
items: 231 km / 2 h 37 south-east through the Chiemgau
Hotel Rosenheimer Hof — keys in the safe by the back door, code 5859#
Hofbräuhaus Traunstein in the evening

days.title: Traunstein → Schönram → Berchtesgaden
items: 23 km / 0 h 21 to Petting for Schönramer Pils
42 km / 0 h 44 on to Berchtesgaden
Alpensport-Hotel Seimler, Maria am Berg — two nights under the Watzmann

days.title: Berchtesgaden
items: Hofbrauhaus Berchtesgaden in the town centre
Watzmann or the Königssee if the weather holds
Second night at the Seimler

days.title: Berchtesgaden → Nesselwang
items: 280 km / 3 h 20 west across Upper Bavaria and the Allgäu
Brauerei-Gasthof Hotel Post, Hauptstraße 25 — sleep above the brewhouse
Dinner in the Gasthof, beer from the tank

days.title: Nesselwang → Missen-Wilhams
items: 43 km / 0 h 33 through the Allgäu hills
Brauereigasthof Schäffler, Hauptstraße 15
A village brewery, a wood stove and nothing else to do

days.title: Missen-Wilhams → Munich
items: 158 km / 1 h 58 north-east on the A96
Hotel Italia, Schillerstraße 19, Ludwigsvorstadt — seven nights
Augustiner Bräustuben for the first Maß

days.title: Munich
items: Augustiner Bräustuben and Augustiner Keller in one day, for science
Viktualienmarkt and the Chinesischer Turm in the Englischer Garten
Schneider Bräuhaus at night

days.title: Munich — west and south
items: Day trip to Kloster Andechs for the Doppelbock (45 km)
Giesinger Bräu on the way back
Isartaler Brauhaus in the evening

days.title: Munich — north
items: Freising and Weihenstephan — the oldest brewery site in the world (38 km)
Wildbräu Grafing on the way back
Paulaner Brauhaus for dinner

days.title: Munich — craft
items: Hopfenhäcker at the Forschungsbrauerei in Perlach — both in one visit
Forschungsbräu Bräustüberl next door
Schweiger Bräu from Markt Schwaben on a menu somewhere in town

days.title: Munich
items: The market and the beer gardens: Viktualienmarkt, Chinesischer Turm, Augustiner Keller
Bookstalls at the Viktualienmarkt if the weather turns
Last long evening in the Altstadt

days.title: Munich
items: Anything missed: Hofbräuhaus, the Deutsches Museum, a second Andechs run
Pack the bottles properly — this is the shopping day
Dinner near the hotel in Ludwigsvorstadt

days.title: Munich → Frankfurt → home
items: 404 km / 3 h 59 north on the A9 and A3
Return the car, check in at Frankfurt
Overnight flight home

Bamberg.name: Schlenkerla
Bamberg.note: Rauchbier since 1405 — beechwood-smoked malt served from oak barrels in a vaulted cellar.
Bamberg.order: Aecht Schlenkerla Rauchbier Märzen, poured in the vaulted cellar

Bamberg.name: Spezial
Bamberg.note: The Bambergers' own rauchbier: the smoke is a whisper next to Schlenkerla.
Bamberg.order: Spezial Rauchbier Lager — the quieter, more local smoke

Bamberg.name: Mahr's Bräu
Bamberg.note: The 'aU' Ungespundetes — unfiltered, naturally carbonated, the classic Franconian lager.
Bamberg.order: The aU at the Schwemme window, glass in hand

Bamberg.name: Fässla
Bamberg.note: Zwergla dark lager, brewery tap opposite Spezial, open late.
Bamberg.order: Zwergla, the dark one, across from Spezial

Bamberg.name: Klosterbräu
Bamberg.note: Bamberg's oldest brewery (1533); the Schwärzla is the one to order.

Bamberg.name: Greifenklau
Bamberg.note: Beer garden above the city with the best view of the roofs.
Bamberg.order: Helles in the garden, with the city below

Nuremberg.name: Altstadthof
Nuremberg.note: Hausbrauerei in the sandstone cellars under the castle — Rotbier and the rock-cut passages.
Nuremberg.order: Hausbrauerei Rotbier, in the cellars cut into the sandstone

Nuremberg.name: Schanzenbräu
Nuremberg.note: Neighbourhood brewery on the hill; unfiltered Franconian styles, taproom with long tables.
Nuremberg.order: Schanzenbräu Helles, unfiltered, on the hill

Nuremberg.name: Tucher Mautkeller
Nuremberg.note: Big vaulted cellar restaurant, Rotbier on tap, convenient on a cold night.
Nuremberg.order: Tucher Rotbier in the vaulted hall

Nuremberg.name: Barfüßer Hausbrauerei
Nuremberg.note: Brewpub by the river with copper kettles in the room and a young crowd.
Nuremberg.order: The house Pils, next to the copper kettles

Essing.name: Gasthaus Felsenwastl
Essing.note: The inn itself: Danube fish, local beer, and the river gorge at the door.
Essing.order: The local Landbier with Danube fish, on the terrace

Essing.name: Kloster Weltenburg
Essing.note: Benedictine abbey 10 km downstream — Asamkirche and the oldest monastery brewery in Bavaria.
Essing.order: Barock Dunkel in the Klosterschenke, with the Danube outside

Essing.name: Befreiungshalle Kelheim
Essing.note: Not a brewery, but the walk up is worth the afternoon before dinner.
Essing.order: No beer here — climb it before dinner instead

Traunstein.name: Hofbräuhaus Traunstein
Traunstein.note: Village-scale Hofbräuhaus with its own maltings; the Hell and the Doppelbock are the local benchmarks.
Traunstein.order: The Hell, then the Doppelbock if it is in season

Traunstein.name: Brauerei Wieninger
Traunstein.note: Family brewery in Teisendorf, 15 km away — a half-day detour if the weather is bad.
Traunstein.order: Wieninger Hell in Teisendorf, 18 km away

Schönram (Petting).name: Private Landbrauerei Schönram
Schönram (Petting).note: One of Germany's most respected private breweries: Schönramer Pils is bitter, floral and dry — the reason to drive to Petting.
Schönram (Petting).order: Schönramer Pils, then the Salome if the shop has it

Berchtesgaden.name: Hofbrauhaus Berchtesgaden
Berchtesgaden.note: The town's own brewery and restaurant; Helles and Dunkel brewed in the valley.
Berchtesgaden.order: Helles, then the Dunkel, in the town's own brewery

Berchtesgaden.name: Grassl Distillery
Berchtesgaden.note: Enzian and fruit brandies, for the non-beer half of the evening.
Berchtesgaden.order: Enzian — not beer, but the local firewater

Berchtesgaden.name: Königssee
Berchtesgaden.note: Electric boat to St. Bartholomä — the scenery half of the two days.
Berchtesgaden.order: Nothing to drink: take the boat to St. Bartholomä

Nesselwang.name: Brauerei-Gasthof Post
Nesselwang.note: Brewery and Gasthof in one building: sleep upstairs, drink the house beer downstairs.
Nesselwang.order: The house Helles, from the tank, at the table above the kettle

Missen-Wilhams.name: Brauereigasthof Schäffler
Missen-Wilhams.note: Allgäu village brewery with a wood-panelled Stube; a handful of beers, all served young.
Missen-Wilhams.order: Whatever is youngest — the beer does not travel far here

Munich.name: Kloster Andechs
Munich.note: Benedictine monastery brewery above the Ammersee (45 km) — Doppelbock Dunkel and a terrace over the valley.
Munich.order: Doppelbock Dunkel on the terrace above the Ammersee

Munich.name: Weihenstephan, Freising
Munich.note: The world's oldest continuously operating brewery site (38 km); the Bräustüberl pours the standards.
Munich.order: Weihenstephaner Helles at the oldest brewery site in the world

Munich.name: Augustiner Bräustuben
Munich.note: The Augustiner brewery tap on Landsberger Straße: Edelstoff from the wooden barrel, meatloaf at the next table.
Munich.order: Edelstoff from the wooden barrel, with meatloaf

Munich.name: Augustiner Keller
Munich.note: Beer garden under the chestnuts; one of the few places still pouring from wooden barrels.

Munich.name: Chinesischer Turm
Munich.note: Englischer Garten beer garden at the pagoda — 7,000 seats, brass band, Maß in hand.
Munich.order: A Maß at the pagoda, with the brass band

Munich.name: Viktualienmarkt
Munich.note: Market beer garden in the centre, with the Maibaum overhead and a rotating brewery tap.
Munich.order: Whatever brewery is on the market tap this month

Munich.name: Schneider Bräuhaus
Munich.note: Wheat-beer house on Tal: Aventinus, the original Tap 7, and a menu built for it.
Munich.order: Aventinus, and the Tap 7 to follow

Munich.name: Paulaner Brauhaus
Munich.note: The Nockherberg brewpub — Salvator season if you are lucky with the calendar.
Munich.order: Salvator if it is March; otherwise the Helles

Munich.name: Giesinger Bräu
Munich.note: Craft brewery in Giesing; Erhellung unfiltered Helles and a taproom full of locals.

Munich.name: Hopfenhäcker
Munich.note: Creative brewery founded 2016 in Haidhausen, moved into the Forschungsbrauerei in Perlach in 2021.
Munich.order: Something hoppy and new — the creative brewery's own

Munich.name: Forschungsbrauerei Bräustüberl
Munich.note: Perlach research brewery and taproom — the same address as Hopfenhäcker, so both in one stop.
Munich.order: The Forschungsbräu Helles, in the taproom next door

Munich.name: Isartaler Brauhaus
Munich.note: Neighbourhood brewpub in the south of the city, house beers brewed on site.
Munich.order: The house beer, brewed in the room

Munich.name: Schweiger Bräu
Munich.note: Private brewery in Markt Schwaben, east of the city — find it on tap around town.
Munich.order: Schweiger Helles on tap somewhere in town — ask which bar has it this week

Munich.name: Wildbräu Grafing
Munich.note: Grafing's own brewery, almost a thousand years of history and eleven classic Bavarian beers.
Munich.order: Wildbräu Helles — eleven classic beers, almost a thousand years

Frankfurt Airport.name: Frankfurt Airport
Frankfurt Airport.note: No beer stop planned — land, collect the car, drive east. The return leg is 404 km before a long flight.
Frankfurt Airport.order: An espresso, then the A3 east

Bamberg.subnote: Hotel Andres, then two days of smoke in the UNESCO old town.

Nuremberg.subnote: Leonard Hotel inside the walls; sandstone cellars under the castle.

Essing.subnote: Gasthaus Felsenwastl on the Danube, the gorge at the door.

Traunstein.subnote: Hotel Rosenheimer Hof — the key is in the safe by the back door.

Schönram (Petting).subnote: A 23 km detour off the Traunstein road that justifies the car.
Schönram (Petting).famous: Schönramer Pils — bitter, floral, bone dry

Berchtesgaden.subnote: Alpensport-Hotel Seimler, Maria am Berg, under the Watzmann.

Nesselwang.subnote: Brauerei-Gasthof Post: sleep above the brewhouse.

Missen-Wilhams.subnote: Brauereigasthof Schäffler, a village brewery with a wood stove.

Munich.subnote: Hotel Italia, Schillerstraße, and the whole city by U-Bahn.
Munich.famous: Helles, Weißbier, and the beer gardens

Frankfurt Airport.subnote: Land, collect the car, drive east. No beer stop planned.
